main_text.p: postea transgressores & contumaces poenis corporalibus puniant; Et sic cum Episcopi in conciliis subscribant definiendo, ut judices: Imperatores ait consentiendo subscripsisse, idque solum in paucis generalibus Conciliis cap. 15.

Nos affirmamus & contra Bellarm. hanc propositionem formamus: Non solum ad Pastores & Doctores Ecclesiae, sed etiam ad Magistratum pertinet judicium de Religione seu rebus fidei & causis Ecclesiasticis, unicè ex verbo Dei instituendum: & quidem ad eum pertinet tum formaliter, tum objectivè. Haec etiam est doctrina totius Ecclesiae Reformatae. Vide speciatim Ivellum Episcopum Sarisburiensem Apolog. capp. 9.10. Item Antapolog. Cap. 9. 10. &c. Chamierum de Oecumenico Pontifice; Wittakerum, Junium cont. Bellarm. Sibbrandum, item Bogermannum cont. Grot. Cll. Proff. Leydens. in Synopsi Disput. XLIX. Cl. Rivetum in Decal, Cl. Walæum de-officio ministrorum. Amesium cont.

page.notes: The "de-officio" line break is marked by a curled mark after "de" in the scan, read here as a printed hyphen; this is doubtful. Italic and roman boundaries in the lower paragraph are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The "Q." before "V." in the running head is a decorative flourish, transcribed as a letter. The "(" before Chamierum is a printed mark, not transcribed.
